Please be gentle with yourself. Rest. Drink some water. Take your time.

I love the person you are, not just the smile you show the world.

                  ♡ Zen

🌙 OPEN BEFORE SLEEP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Whatever today was like, you made it through. That's enough for tonight.

Close your eyes. Let tomorrow wait.

Goodnight, Qish. Sweet dreams, sayang.

                  ♡ Zen
